## Hypothesis

We hypothesize that the current engine's trigger logic misses the optimal entry timing on 4/29 and 5/01 winner days, causing losses instead of capturing the expected gains. A new trigger designed to enter earlier or with different confirmation criteria could convert these losing days into winners while maintaining discipline on loser days.

## Mechanism

Test a modified entry trigger that combines the existing BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON conditions with an additional VIX-rising filter and earlier time window (09:35-10:00 ET) to capture the initial rejection move more reliably. Exit logic remains unchanged (chart-stop primary, chandelier profit-lock, ribbon-ride management).
